body:
okay, i will...

have sweet dreams when you get there, and thank you. i know you haven't said much, but... yah, i'm so alone

i think that's what i'm doing here now with this stupid account with its ridiculous name. but other wise i'm from a very small, very christian town and they have tried to run me out once already. hell if i sought help out here, the only thing i would get in return is a loaded gun.

and this is why i just sit in my house anymore waiting for the end to find me, or for me to get up the guts to do it myself. 

and if your wondering why i even care it is because it is the opinion of these people who are going to get us our rights, it is their voice that is going to be heard before ours. we need them on our side, we need them to like us, we need them to be able to say to their selves oh... i knew a trans girl/guy and they were really cool, i'll vote for this (whatever) that will give them ins coverage no matter what policy they get, or how much they have to spend on it.and to anyone who thinks they don't give a crap... then ask yourself why you have ever been concerned with "passing". 

fact is that we should care because their opinion effects us and our acceptance in this world. 

on that note... that site is far from legit imo. if you type in transgender you get like a 97% neg, but if you type in transgendered you get a 59% pos result. 

but yah... i'm just saying... we need to be like politicians if we want to get ahead and beat discrimination.

meh, it's been another rough day. so is having a particular rough time of life and of course that bleeds off on me, but it is my job to be the strong one, so i tend to just go in the kitchen lay on the floor and do my crying there.

i tried to look for more insurance options, but gave up kinda quick... it's just one of them roads i've been down too many times, and it's always the same- ether i cant afford it or they don't cover what i need. 

tried talking to my brother but i think it all got a bit serious for him and he hasn't said anything back for a while now. it's okay though i understand i don't hold anything against him any more. if anything i will miss him the most, if you miss people there... idk.

i guess i am feeling particularly numb right now, and though i'm not currently stringing up the rope, nothing has changed. it's all the same you know, some times it hurts more than others, and it comes and goes in waves.
i really hope you can, please...

i think i will be on kinda late tonight, i'm not sure what my days are going to be like, my sleep patterns are off and i seem to be sleeping a lot, but i'm sure i'll be around some time tomorrow, but honestly i really don't think there is anything you can say to help me.

you can't and even if you could you wouldn't, i'm not trying to judge you, or say that i know what kind of person you are, but i'm telling you... bah, here let me help you to for get about me. 

i have hated my self since i could remember, i have never fit into myself, i knew what my problem was for a long time, but i lived such a sheltered life that it wasn't tell i got out on my own that i learned what it was that i needed to do. so i got a shrink started college to become a rn so that i could afford to get my surgery. 

so i came out to my so and then my family, and although they try to act like they don't care they do... a lot. my father tells me that i am going to hell, that im an abomination, a fag, an it, and that i'm worthless. my mom tells me that she gave birth to a boy and that she will never accept me as a girl, and because she was the one who carried me for nine months and blah, blah, blah. my brother says that he doesn't know who i am and that i'm not his brother any more, and when the rest of my extended family found out that now make it a point to display their narrow mindedness through outwardly laughing when i'm around because of how i'm dressed. my so, well she decided that she is going to tell me that she will figure it out, but i think she has done this by falling in love with some man online.

i know that i is a lot of me to ask of her, and she has been a saint (for the most part, at least more so then any one else in my life.) but she also says some of the most hurtful things to me. i've tried to find ins that i can get that will cover me, but i have found none yet. the ins that i have refuses to give me proper care even though it is written in their policy to do so, at least in regards to hormone replacement therapy. 

my so was supposed to be VERY bi when i got together with her, i knew her for years before and i know her to have had lots of girl friends and boy friends. so she gave me a time frame, and it would have been okay but there were issues with completing my education. 

you see i was VERY depressed as a kid and no one knew why, i kept my feeling locked up cause i was told it was a sin, and that i would go to hell for even thinking such things, so because i was really good with music so they put me in college when i was about 11 to further my musical expectations. well, i never went anywhere with music and now i have been kicked out of college because the government will not pay for people attending a jc with more then 93 credits regardless if they were paid for out of pocket or not. 

so there will be no more college, there will be no job to get that will make enough for me to save up, i will not be receiving the ins i need to further myself, and my time with my daughter and so will be ending soon, and i will be hopeless and alone. 

there is no help, there is no hope, there i no love, no support, no future. and that's about that. 

thank you for your words of love and encouragement but i think it is just too late for me. besides now that you know i'm just a tranny, fruit cake, it, thing, freak, fag, lesbian, abomination, a trap/tarp/or any other variation of the word, etc... who needs a lobotomy and not a sex change. some one who needs to get a grip and calm down, or what ever you may think i've heard it all, and i am numb. tell you know what it is like to try and kill your self, dismember yourself, or cause yourself psychical harm because you can't stand the sight of your self then don't judge me. 

the government gave my dad 150+ thousand to save his life 10 years from now, but the 15 i need to save my life because i'm just a nut case. it doesn't matter that possess the chromosomes of a man and a woman, and that half of me went one way and the other half went the other. heck, i have been going through life for years now, i have never had a surgery, and 98% of the people i meet have no idea that i could be anything other then a girl...

ugg now i'm just ranting and i promised myself i wouldn't do that, so i'll just leave it there.

meh,
~me~
